title: Design System: PAIS Scoped Operational Modules

authority.implementation: src/pages/RecordsModules.css; ModulePages.css; PromotionPage.css; ReportsPage.css; DocumentsPage.css; ExcelIntegrationPage.css; AdminAccountsPage.css
authority.otherPages: Incumbent components, global CSS, and .21st/design.json decisions remain authoritative. This sidecar grants no wider redesign authority.

shadows.name: record-section
shadows.purpose: Scoped sections use borders and tonal grouping.

limitations: No populated academic/training entries available for review

extensionReview.captures: .impeccable/review: promotion, reports, worksheets, documents, accounts desktop and mobile PNGs
extensionReview.limitation: Original Orders/Education Ship at bounded scope disposition does not certify these later extensions.

narrative.overview: Confirmed clean, professional navy-and-white direction for Orders and Education & Training, subsequently extended by user authorization to Promotion, Reports, Excel Worksheets, Document Editor, and Administrator Accounts. All seven modules inherit the existing PAIS light and dark theme; other pages retain incumbent design authority.
keyCharacteristics: Orders: seven summary cells, search first, collapsed general and advanced filters, scrolling table
Education & Training: five summary cells, native personnel details, academic and training columns stacking on mobile
Selection separate from disclosure; entry actions remain visible
Promotion and Reports: compact scrolling tables, wrapping tabs, search/filter context
Document Editor: searchable document list, visible actions, responsive template catalogue
Excel Worksheets: dense ribbon/formula tools and local scrolling within the workbench
Administrator Accounts: three-cell summary, search, readable scrolling register

rules.name: Bounded module scope
rules.body: Preserve the incumbent design authority for all other pages and the existing PAIS theme, permissions, data, and document workflows.

dos: Do use live PAIS aliases for light and dark themes
Do keep search prominent and record copy readable
donts: Don't widen the redesign to other modules
Don't claim populated-entry or mutation-flow verification from this review
